SELECT
    o.weathprofile AS condition_name,
    AVG(s.snrratio) AS average_quality_value,
    COUNT(s.signalregistry) AS usable_signals_count
FROM
    signals AS s
JOIN
    observatories AS o ON s.telescref = o.observstation
GROUP BY
    o.weathprofile
ORDER BY
    average_quality_value;
```

This PostgreSQL query retrieves the average signal-to-noise ratio (`snrratio`) and the count of signal registries (`signalregistry`) for each weather profile (`weathprofile`) from the `observatories` table. It joins the `signals` table with the `observatories` table on the `telescref` and `observstation` columns, respectively. The results are grouped by `weathprofile` and ordered by the average quality value (`average_quality_value`). The column names, types, ordering, and parameter positions are preserved as requested.
